primitives.name: Compile-time Guard for Per-Player Projection Publishing
primitives.verbatim_quote: **canPublishProjections stays false after wiring** — `variance-honesty.test.ts`, plus a compile-time guard (`ProcessGradeIsNeverPublishable`) added this session.
primitives.assumptions: The guard is inserted at compile time to prevent any per-player projection from being published unless explicitly overridden by a founder override flag.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ProcessGradeIsNeverPublishable is true, the entire per-player projection pipeline is locked down, preventing publication of any player-specific band.

layer2.mapping: In GSI, this enforces the principle that projections must pass a minimum quality threshold before being released to clients. In GSE, it prevents the system from transitioning into a publishable state unless all internal consistency checks have been verified.
layer2.telemetry: The compile-time boolean flag serves as an immutable audit trail, ensuring that any change to the publishing status requires explicit developer acknowledgment.

primitives.name: Variance-Honesty Assertion Suite
primitives.verbatim_quote: **canPublishProjections stays false after wiring** — `variance-honesty.test.ts`, plus a compile-time guard (`ProcessGradeIsNeverPublishable`) added this session.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_{\\text{honesty}}': 'Binary hypothesis test, dimensionless', '\\mathcal{M}_{\\text{variance}}': 'Model configuration space, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: The suite assumes that the underlying variance model is correctly specified and that the wiring logic does not introduce spurious publication permissions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If the wiring logic incorrectly sets canPublishProjections to true despite invalid input, the suite will fail, indicating a violation of honesty constraints.

layer2.mapping: This suite maps directly to GSI's requirement for transparent and verifiable projection pipelines. It ensures that the system's internal state remains consistent with its external behavior, preventing any hidden leaks of sensitive information.
layer2.telemetry: The pass/fail outcome of the suite provides a clear signal to developers about whether the current implementation respects the established honesty criteria.

primitives.verbatim_quote: **Season-freshness assertion, fails loudly** — `variance-projections.test.ts` "SEASON FRESHNESS: throws loudly when the source is older than the forecast", and the wiring suite's "never registers when the training window

layer2.telemetry: The thrown exception serves as a critical alert, logging the discrepancy between source age and forecast date for immediate investigation.
